**Your 2‑day balanced cultural & culinary getaway in Djerba**

| Day | Theme | Time | What & Why | Cost (TND) |
|-----|-------|------|------------|------------|
| **Day 1** | Cultural immersion & local flavors | 09:00‑10:30 | **Houmt Souk Medina** – wander the historic medina, discover souks, traditional fondouks and vibrant street life. *(Free)* | 0 |
| | | 11:00‑12:30 | **Lunch – Café Toumana** – cozy lounge serving authentic Tunisian dishes, vegetarian‑friendly. *(Local favorite, close to the medina)* | 30 |
| | | 13:00‑15:00 | **Djerba Heritage Village** – living museum of traditional houses, pottery workshops and Berber‑Arab heritage. *(Entry 8 TND)* | 8 |
| | | 15:30‑16:30 | **Camel Ride on Djerba Beach** – low‑intensity ride along the golden shore, perfect for a romantic touch. *(Bookable, 45 TND)* | 45 |
| | | 19:00‑21:00 | **Dinner – Dar Maison** – fine‑dining in a restored Djerbian Menzel, refined Tunisian cuisine. *(Elegant, romantic)* | 60 |
| **Day 2** | Island heritage tour & seaside relaxation | 09:00‑15:00 | **Full Island Discovery Tour** – guided tour covering El Ghriba Synagogue, Guellala pottery village, and Houmt Suk historic streets. *(All‑day cultural highlight, 75 TND)* | 75 |
| | | 15:30‑16:30 | **Sidi Mahrez Beach** – unwind on white‑sand, swim in calm waters, enjoy the sea breeze. *(Free)* | 0 |
| | | 18:00‑20:00 | **Dinner – La Marina Djerba** – seafood restaurant on the Houmt Suk marina, fresh catches and Mediterranean flavours. *(Great farewell dinner)* | 55 |
| **Accommodation** | **Hotel Ksar Djerba – Charming Stay** (Boutique hotel, central, excellent value) | 1 night | 75 TND per night | 75 |

### Budget Overview
| Category | Cost (TND) |
|----------|------------|
| Activities (tour + camel ride) | 120 |
| Accommodation (1 night) | 75 |
| Meals (4 lunches/dinners) | 195 |
| Transport (taxi / short transfers) | 40 |
| **Total** | **430 TND** |

### Quick Tips
- Bring a light scarf for sun protection and modest dress when visiting religious sites (e.g., El Ghriba Synagogue).  
- Sample the local specialty **couscous au poisson** (fish couscous).  
- Reserve the Full Island Discovery Tour and the camel ride ahead of time to guarantee spots.  

Enjoy a perfectly balanced mix of Djerba’s rich culture, delicious food, and relaxed seaside moments! 🌞🏖️🍽️
